events.text: The great houses are all still settling their own lands: none will march on you for a while. But outlaws haunt the woods and know what a new village keeps, and a band will come for your stores within the first quarter hour. Keep your retinue at home while you see to food, wood and homes, and when the outlaws come, select it and right-click them.
5 of Cranholm Castle's people fled; they will come back if it is fed and safe.
You found 21 gold in Cranholm Castle.
You are now a lord. You may give villages to vassals to run for you, lay out whole quarters from town templates, call the banners, and drill veterans at a barracks into serjeants and yeoman archers.
Ashford: The governor has set the villagers to build a tannery, to raise the tax.
4 newcomers settle at Ashford, with 25 stone.
Outlaws out of the greenwood are on the road to Ashford: 15 men, come for your stores. Order your retinue at them when they reach the village.
Ashford: Your soldiers go out to drive the raiders from the village. (Hold keeps them at the keep.)
Cranholm Castle eats from your granaries.
The outlaws are beaten off at Ashford: 10 of them fell, none of ours.
Cranholm Castle: Your soldiers go out to drive the raiders from the village. (Hold keeps them at the keep.)
The outlaws are beaten off at Cranholm Castle: 5 of them fell, none of ours.

chronicle.text: You took Cranholm Castle from the free folk.

houses.name: House Varn
houses.blurb: Lean and scarred. Burns villages and strikes at supply.
taunts: I take what I can carry. Next time I bring more carts.
Count your villages tonight. Count them again in the morning.

houses.name: House Dunmore
houses.blurb: Young and reckless. Knights and cavalry, challenges and charges.
taunts: Meet me in the open field, if you dare.
My knights are bored. You will do.
Hide behind your walls, then. I will ride around them.

houses.name: House Wyndham
houses.blurb: Marriages, bribes and betrayal. Backs whoever is winning.
taunts: How kind of you to weaken my rivals for me.
Every lord has a price. I wonder what yours is.
A pity. I had such hopes for you.

houses.name: House Carrow
houses.blurb: Grows great villages and fine stone castles. Slow to war, hard to break.
taunts: I build for a hundred years. You build for a summer.
War is a poor trade. You will learn the price.

houses.name: House Penhallow
houses.blurb: Market towns and gold. Fights with hired swords.
taunts: My sellswords cost less than your harvest.
Everything is for sale. Even your keep.
I have hired better men than you for less.
